title: South East Queensland Water Security Program
notes: Covers SEQ Water Grid operations, Wyaralong connection planning, Gold Coast desalination expansion business case and Western Corridor recycled-water use.

title: Recycled Water
notes: Western Corridor Recycled Water Scheme retained as drought-response and longer-term supply option.

title: Water storage / Greater Sydney system
notes: Greater Sydney uses 11 major supply dams linked by rivers, pipes and canals; Warragamba capacity 2,064,680 ML and supplies roughly 80% of Sydney drinking water via Prospect WFP.

title: ACT-QBN water storage levels
notes: Total usable dam storage around 278 GL after enlarged Cotter; Murrumbidgee-to-Googong transfer supplements storage.

title: Googong Dam
notes: 119.4 GL storage on Queanbeyan River; major ACT/QBN source.

title: Melbourne Water Outlook 2026
notes: Tracks storage, inflow, demand and desalination response; 2026 dry conditions triggered 150 GL desalination order.

title: Water Security Plan for Melbourne Geelong and connected towns
notes: South-Central Water Grid serves over 80% of Victoria; government says up to an additional 95 GL/year may be needed by 2030 beyond existing desalination capacity.

title: Victorian desalination
notes: Wonthaggi plant up to 150 GL/year; 84 km two-way transfer pipeline into south-central grid.

title: Riverina Water supply system
notes: Wagga system combines Murrumbidgee River and multiple groundwater borefields; regulated river flows influenced by Burrinjuck and Blowering dams.

title: Wagga Wagga Water Treatment Plant
notes: 55 ML/day treatment plant opened 2021; supports broader Riverina Water network and growth to 2050.

title: Albury water cycle
notes: Murray River below Hume is source; two plants each up to 70 ML/day plus separate raw-water industrial network.

title: Goulburn water supply services
notes: Pejar 9,000 ML, Sooley 6,250 ML and Rossi Weir 330 ML are principal listed storages.
